Name: Television Makeover - Catalogue Upgrades - Vanilla and Bog Recolor Options for AT
Author: ashleyketchumtr
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/g1iUY3A.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://imgur.com/yhGEUJb.png[/img]﻿[/center][font=Georgia]
[b][center]Give your in-game TVs a fresh look with designs matching the new catalogues from the 1.6 Stardew Valley update. This pack includes new variants for the Budget TV, Floor TV, and Plasma TV, featuring styles from the Joja, Retro, Wizard, and Junimo Catalogues.

I have also included a separate file that includes a recolor to match [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/about-me?gameId=1303]BogWyytch's[/url] Krobus Retro, Wizard, and Seasonal Junimo catalogue recolors!


[img]https://imgur.com/WIj4nRN.png[/img]﻿[/center][/b]
[/font][center][font=Georgia]Ensure you have[b] Alternative Textures[/b] installed.
[font=Georgia]Download and extract into your Mods folder.[/font]
[font=Georgia]Purchase the [b]paint bucket[/b] from Robin to apply the new designs.[/font]
[/font][font=Georgia]
